Service-only client adapter for existing listing_quality_criterion_record. Requires immutable evidence artifact refs, exact current lease/revision/fingerprint, explicit stage/actor and independent reviewer evidence. Writes immutable pending request before RPC, verifies exact receipt; unknown outcome exact-resume only.

Narrow stage-only collection/checklist snapshot and later explicit criterion-record-before-task-finish orchestration; preserve original source budgets/task lease and known receipt recovery. No implicit new source/content writes.
Source/render/journey evidence separation, all family/owner/clear/hold/partial-offering boundaries; unsupported checks cannot pass; stage-only no finish; unknown outcomes no retry or next lease.
Actual guarded canonical functions with two fingerprints/lease timing, stale source/revision/owner, independent actor/artifact, request idempotency, lost response and post-finish refusal.

optional_later_paths_not_yet_owned.purpose: Retain real bounded screenshots and explicit safe local action receipts; no write/submit/payment/owner/provider actions. Any unexercised primary action remains a blocker.

Publish bounded immutable evidence through EXISTING Actions artifact store BEFORE criterion RPC; preserve artifact URL+archive digest and entry hashes; specialist recording and task finish then separate receipt artifact. Independent reviewer stage must be a separate actual review, never CI self-signoff.
Explicit bounded collect/stage/record/resume modes; no disabled-policy bypass or renewal. Public read mode has no service credential and cannot call lease/finish/criterion RPC.
Separate targeted source identity parity investigation with exact canonical family/branch rules; do not relax ambiguous types or infer source scope.
Separate fresh-only generic/rendered draft parity followup, no identity promotion/source approval or owner edits.

canonical_protocol: Use existing canonical quality task lease for exact task classification/design/verification; no alternate queue, writer or lease. While automatic request is disabled, no automatic acquisition.

Read current listing_quality_checklist and bind criterion key/revision/family and criterion fingerprint separately from task lease fingerprint. Retain immutable actual source/public/render/action artifacts, original timestamps, exact hashes and source context.

Build a bounded plan for each applicable criterion. Metadata presence/HTTP200 are insufficient. Source identity/imagery/manual facts, visual design and unavailable owner/provider journeys stay unverified/blocked unless actually reviewed or exercised.

Archive evidence in existing Actions artifacts, retain HTTPS artifact URL and archive SHA256 plus exact entry hashes. Do not claim a local sha256 URI satisfies the existing HTTPS evidence API. No geography archive kind masquerade, public full HTML dump or competing store.

For supported explicit specialist decisions, prepare immutable request UUID/payload, then call existing criterion writer while exact task lease still valid. Never record after task_finish consumed the lease. Expired or changed context stops; no blind new lease/retry.
Call task_finish only after known per-criterion recording outcomes or an explicit plan-only/no-criterion decision. Aggregate task status remains separate from criterion/home completeness.

Independent reviewer must inspect original evidence AND new independently produced evidence, use distinct actor/stage and exact specialist ID/current fingerprint/revision/commit. Service trust boundary does not justify inventing independent review.

Persist exact receipts. Lost response resumes the same immutable request only; existing request replay can return historical recorded success, so reread current checklist before saying signed_off/current. Never promote stale replay to current acceptance.

Root approval of a fresh finite audit request/schedule is separate from source implementation. Shared affected families use the same planner and parameterized record context; six records are representative evidence, not catalogue completion.
